# blend-website — working notes

The marketing site: static HTML, one file per page, styles and scripts
inlined per page, deployed by Vercel from `main` with `cleanUrls`. There is
no build step and no package.json; what is in the file is what ships.

## Product UI

**Product UI mockups come only from `blend-mockups/`, generated by the
webapp team's mockup script. Never hand-build or restyle product UI on the
website; request new or changed mockups instead.**

A hand-drawn approximation of the app drifts from the app within a release
and nobody notices, because the person who would notice does not read this
repo. `blend-mockups/` is produced from the real components, so when the
product changes the mockups change with it.

- `tools/scope-mockups.mjs <path-to-webapp>/blend-mockups` copies a new
  export in and rewrites its stylesheet under a `.bm-root` scope. The export
  is a Tailwind build whose preflight is not prefixed, so unscoped it strips
  heading weights and list markers from whatever page it lands on.
- Fragments are copied byte for byte and inlined in the page between
  `<!-- mockup:id -->` markers. Placement, scale, cropping, zone
  highlighting and entrance animation are this repo's job; everything
  inside the fragment is theirs.
- If a mockup is missing, wrong, or needs a mobile variant, ask the webapp
  team for it. Do not patch it here.

## Prices

`pricing.json` is where plan prices are written. `index.html` still carries
its own copy in `data-price-*` attributes on each tier;
`node tools/check-prices.mjs` refuses when the two disagree. Run it before
merging anything that touches either.

## Before merging

- `node tools/check-prices.mjs`
- the visual-diff suite in the workspace: `cd ../../tools/visual-diff && npm run check`
